body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request implements auto-layout for DetailView/DetailSection and migrates Console ObjectView from hardcoded Sheet drawer to the platform's NavigationOverlay component. The changes enable multi-column detail views with intelligent column inference and unified navigation behavior across the platform.

**Changes:**
- Added auto-layout engine for detail views with column inference (≤3→1col, 4-10→2col, 11+→3col) and automatic full-width spanning for wide field types
- Console now uses NavigationOverlay with ViewNavigationConfig support instead of hardcoded Sheet, enabling configurable navigation modes (drawer/modal/split/popover)
- DetailView no longer forces columns: 2 fallback, delegating to auto-layout when columns is undefined
